subject.title: Del Mar Union School District Board

text: I bring 30 years of combined experience as an educator, university professor, and administrator, DMUSD School Board Trustee, and special education law attorney. I hold a Ph.D. in Education, three California teaching credentials, a California Administrative Services Credential, and a license to practice law in California. As a former DMUSD School Board Trustee, I worked to protect educational excellence, fiscal responsibility, transparency, and public accountability. I also served as president of our regional special education consortium and as a delegate to the California School Boards Association.

This combination of classroom, administrative, legal, and governance experience has prepared me to address the complex responsibilities facing today’s school boards. I understand student needs, educational law, responsible budgeting, and the importance of listening to teachers, parents, and taxpayers.

My priorities are clear: maintain exceptional academic standards; recruit and retain outstanding teachers; safeguard special education services; keep classrooms focused on learning; manage public funds responsibly; and ensure parents are respected, heard, and welcomed as partners.

As a longtime community member and father whose children attended Del Mar schools, I know what makes this district special. I would be honored to serve again—with experience, independence, sound judgment, and an unwavering commitment to every student.

text: For the past 16 years, it has been my privilege to serve as a member of the Governing Board of Trustees for the Del Mar Union School District. Throughout my service on the school board, I’ve helped the district through a financial downturn, a global pandemic, (DMUSD - first to reopen) and a great recession, and assisted DMUSD in becomming one of the strongest districts in California.

Collaborating with board members, educators, parents and our community I worked to maintain balanced budgets, built new schools, creating innovative learning environments to prepare students for the future. All our programs focus on inclusion of all students, and the provision of the best education, resources, and opportunities they deserve.

Today, DMUSD students rank among the highest-performing in California. A testament to exceptional teachers, dedicated staff, and committement to academic excellence. These achievements reflect thoughtful leadership, long-term planning, fiscal responsibility, and shared vision for educational success for all students.

If re-elected, I will continue to advocate for academic excellence, fiscal stewardship, exceptional educators, and opportunities for every student. It has been my honor to serve this community, and I respectfully ask for your vote in order to continue building on DMUSD’s tradition of excellence.

text: Proudly endorsed for re-election by the Del Mar California Teachers Association, and multiple past Presidents of the Governing Board of the Del Mar Union School District.
Del Mar and Carmel Valley have nationally recognized schools built on high academic standards and disciplined budgeting, the foundation of our community and our property values.

As your incumbent voice on the Del Mar Union School District Board of Trustees, I apply my business management and corporate governance experience to work for our students. During my tenure, we achieved top 1% test scores in California schools, while maintaining a balanced budget with a healthy fiscal reserve.

My focus remains responsible budgeting and strategic resource allocation to keep class sizes low, attract and retain the best teachers, and hold every school to high standards. As a parent of two DMUSD graduates, quality education is personal to me.

My career started in the United States Air Force developing educational software and training instructors. The Air Force sponsored degrees in Engineering (UCLA), Business (Embry-Riddle) and Law (Loyola). I applied this education to leadership roles in healthcare, defense, communications and software.
I use these leadership skills from business and government service to promote best practices for DMUSD.
Please help me continue championing educational excellence in Del Mar and Carmel Valley.
I humbly ask for your vote for re-election.
